from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re

at=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
def rel(p):
    return str(Path(p).relative_to(r)).replace("\\","/")
def ref(p):
    return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def save(name,d):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("当前完成产物已存在，不覆盖："+name)
    p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,default=str)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    return ref(p)
